body:
# 🌌 SoulForge

✨ **The Ultimate High-Stakes Hardcore SMP Core** ✨

**SoulForge** is an advanced, performance-optimized survival mechanics plugin designed for competitive SMP, factions, and hardcore networks. Merging the intense thrill of life-stealing networks with mechanical item-based value, SoulForge turns every PvP encounter into a brutal struggle for survival. 

When a player falls in battle, their lifeforce is physically shattered into commodity pieces. Survival is no longer cheap—it must be forged.

---

## 🚀 Key Features

* **⚔️ True High-Stakes PvP:** When a player kills another player in PvP, a physical **Soul Shard** drops at the victim's feet, accompanied by a dynamic lightning strike sound effect and special particle trails.
* **🛡️ Hardcore Life Insurance:** If a player has a custom-crafted **Soul Totem** in their inventory upon taking fatal PvP damage, the totem is consumed to anchor their soul, keeping them safe and online.
* **❌ Vanilla Totem Rejection:** Say goodbye to endless raid farm exploits. Standard vanilla totems are completely disabled and will shatter into glass pieces if used, forcing players to engage with the server economy.
* **🔒 Seamless Elimination & Revival:** Players killed without a Soul Totem are temporarily banned ("Shattered"). Teammates must gather rare shards and diamonds to forge a **Revival Core**, right-clicking it to restore their ally to the living world.
* **⚡ Ultra-Optimized Backend:** Built strictly with native Paper/Spigot APIs and utilizing standard `PersistentDataContainer` tracking. Zero reliance on external libraries means zero performance lag and complete security against item-renaming duplication exploits.

---

## 🧪 Custom Items & Recipes

SoulForge introduces three strictly registered custom tiers using secure internal data tags. 

### 🧊 1. Soul Shard
* **Base Material:** Ghast Tear (`GHAST_TEAR`)
* **In-Game Display:** `§b§lSoul Shard`
* **Description:** The ultimate server commodity. Dropped only upon a physical PvP kill.

### 👑 2. Soul Totem (The Insurance Policy)
